title: Comparison of pravastatin with crystalline nicotinic acid monotherapy in treatment of combined hyperlipidemia.
abstract: Pravastatin treatment of combined hyperlipidemia lowers low-density lipoprotein effectively; nicotinic acid lowers remnant cholesterol and raises high-density lipoprotein. A combination of these 2 drugs may be indicated for optimal treatment of lipoprotein abnormalities in combined hyperlipidemia.
